summary: Adamas Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into an equity distribution agreement with JonesTrading, BTIG, and B. Riley Securities for an at-the-market offering of common stock up to $250M. The shares will be sold under Rule 415 in ordinary brokers' transactions on Nasdaq. No price, premium, or timeline is specified. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation.
